scope: Fresh local user-experience audit; synthetic providers and disposable databases only

baseline.database_scope_note: Initial Django startup probes the configured SQLite schema before pytest creates the test database. Final test settings isolate this bootstrap.

limits: No live provider/model requests, emails, paid enrichment or deployment.
Existing user records were not inspected. Explicit migrations used disposable databases; initial pytest startup performed the idempotent registry schema probe, now isolated.
Browser setup used existing synthetic credentials.
Blob backup download was triggered with success feedback but downloaded file was not captured by browser automation.
Full source line-by-line reinspection and every possible button/input/outage were not claimed.
